hud.coachmark_text: Everything important lives here: Build, Decorate, Travel, Arcade, Album, Wardrobe, Furniture, Profile and IGohbie. The eye below shows what Gooby wants right now.

items.text: GOOBY has been rebuilt from the ground up — faster, prettier and even fluffier.
Place furniture freely on the grid, rearrange and make it truly cozy.
Drive through the city yourself, discover places and fly off on vacation.
Visit your friends, play board games together — and lovingly throw tomatoes.
The arcade is back — with Goobys vs Zombies and more minigames.
Your old save moves in with you — nothing gets lost.

news.untertitel: Rebuilt from scratch — with lots of love.
